correctness.rationale: Prefix extension exhausts ternary linear square-free words, because adding a letter can only introduce a suffix square. Independent implementation gives 168546 at n=36,219516 at n=37. Testing every cyclic start and every half-length h with 2h<=n in ww gives 16416 and 18870 circular-square-free representatives; checking all 36*3 insertions for each n36 circular candidate against the exhaustive n37 set yields 540 extremal linear representatives. Each is primitive, hence exactly 540/36=15 circular rotation classes. Complete S_3 letter permutations and reversal action gives exactly 3 symmetry orbits of sizes 3,6,6 and reproduces three stated representatives. No extrapolation beyond n36.

value.rationale: Length 36 is mathematically singled out by the published sharp existence spectrum as the final isolated attainable length before the forbidden 37 and all lengths >=38. Classifying EVERY extremal object at this natural boundary into 15 rotation classes and 3 symmetry types supplies complete combinatorial information not obtainable from an existence witness; finite scope is intrinsically justified by the boundary.

limitations: n=36 only, not counts for any other attainable lengths or an asymptotic orbit theorem.
